criteria.requirement: Add cachetools.keys.signature_key(func,*,typed=False,namespace=None,ignore=()), returning a key callable. Use signature.bind/apply_defaults so equivalent positional/keyword/default calls share a key, include variadic positional order and sorted variadic keywords, and optionally top-level value types (including variadic item types). Default namespace is function identity; allow explicit shared hashable namespace and explicit known ignored parameter names. Preserve binding errors and reject unhashable values without stringifying them. Do not mutate kwargs, execute the wrapped function or change existing key functions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
